decisions.decision: Educational projections, scenarios, explanations only; no regulated product recommendations
Member-transcribed official CPF LIFE estimate required for personal projections; examples are illustrations
Retain 96 archetypes with consumer-facing provisional descriptions; hide numerical confidence claims
Every adult requires separately verified identity and purpose-specific consent before financial sharing; sharing blocked pending provider
Prioritise five high-value scenario engines before remainder, with separate acceptance cases
Request reviewer credentials/proposals/quotations first; no appointment or spending without approval
Assume consumer research success for development planning only; 48 actual sessions required before external pilot
